handouts.title: Station map v3
handouts.location: Control station plan / posted facility layout
handouts.clue: Eight numbered airtight shutters; M-1 links Loading and Dock for personnel only.

handouts.title: Dock arrival / departure history
handouts.location: At Dock on arrival — show automatically
handouts.clue: An arrival repeats exactly one hour later with no departure between them; there is no commissioned audio about the loop.

handouts.title: S-06 / H-1 pressure-hatch diagnostics
handouts.location: Inspect H-1 or Loading / search pressure-hatch archive
handouts.clue: A large pressure differential makes opening hazardous. EQ-1 equalizes but does not stop inflow; M-1 is a people-only bypass. Future-dated 2237-311 19:12:36.

handouts.title: LOC-1 local restart controller
handouts.location: Inspect LOC-1 or its diagram in Tank Gallery
handouts.clue: Local auto-retry is independent of SCH-1. NORMAL STOP does not block restart; latched emergency isolation and motor-breaker lockout do.

handouts.title: Nell's handwritten maintenance note
handouts.location: Nell / Lab notes / investigate feed discrepancy
handouts.clue: P-1 stopped and CV-1 closed, yet the tank continued rising and the transfer-flow indicator remained above zero.

handouts.title: Cairn analyzer service tag
handouts.location: Inspect the leased cart in Lab / equipment paperwork
handouts.clue: Separate data and sample-water connections. Data removal loses Control live trend, not Gallery mechanical gauge; isolate and drain the tap before moving.

handouts.title: P-1 emergency-isolation placard
handouts.location: Pump Room safety panel / S-04 and S-05 inspections
handouts.clue: Emergency isolation cuts motor power immediately, warns for 10 seconds, then closes BOTH S-04 and S-05 / F-1. NORMAL STOP and breaker lockout leave shutters open.
